home.headline: Get the right help for civic issues in Chennai
home.lead: Describe a problem in English, Tamil or Hindi. CivicAssist suggests which authority handles it, how to contact them, and helps you prepare a clear complaint letter.
home.input_placeholder: For example: The streetlight near the bus stop on 3rd Main Road, Adyar has not worked for a week.
home.input_hint: Do not include phone numbers or Aadhaar numbers. They are masked automatically if you do.
home.chat_instead: Prefer to chat? Use the Civic Assistant
home.shortcut_schemes: Find a government scheme or rule
home.shortcut_followup: Follow up on a complaint you already filed

1.title: Describe
1.body: Tell us what is wrong and where, in your own words and language.

2.title: Clarify
2.body: Answer a few short questions only when they change where the complaint should go.

3.title: Get a recommendation
3.body: See the likely authority, the verified way to contact them, and what to keep ready.

4.title: Submit and track
4.body: Prepare a letter, submit it yourself on the official channel, then keep track of the reference number here.

home.what_title: What CivicAssist does and does not do

what.1: Suggests the authority and official channel, with the source page and the date it was checked.
what.2: Prepares a complaint letter in English, Tamil or Hindi that you can edit, copy or download as a PDF.
what.3: Never submits a complaint, sends an email or contacts a department on your behalf.
what.4: Works without AI. AI is used only to help understand free text or polish wording, and only when available.

home.independent_body: CivicAssist is not run by the Greater Chennai Corporation or any government department. Always check the official portal before you submit.

about.title: About CivicAssist
about.intro: An independent tool that helps Chennai residents find the right authority for a civic problem and prepare a clear complaint.

what.title: What it is
body: CivicAssist turns a description of a civic problem into a suggestion: which authority probably handles it, which official channel to use, and what details to keep ready.
It also prepares a complaint letter in English, Tamil or Hindi and lets you keep a private record of the reference number you receive.

independent.title: Independent and unofficial
body: CivicAssist is not affiliated with the Greater Chennai Corporation, Chennai Metro Water, TNPDCL, the Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board or any government body.
It never submits complaints, sends emails or contacts any department for you. You always submit on the official channel yourself.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: You do not need an account. Your name, address and phone number for the letter stay in your browser and are never sent to AI or stored by CivicAssist.
If you choose to save a complaint record, it is stored without your name or phone number and can be opened only with its private link. You can delete it at any time from My Complaints.

ai.title: Use of AI
body: AI is optional. When available, it helps read free-text descriptions, rewrite search questions and polish letter wording. Phone numbers, emails and ID numbers are masked before any text is sent.

Requests go through the site's server to Google Gemini (through the Netlify AI Gateway) or Groq. Authority routing, safety advice and official links come from built-in rules and the verified knowledge base, not from AI.

languages.title: Languages
body: The interface, guidance and letters are available in English, Tamil and Hindi. You can write in any of them, or mix them.
The government scheme records are in English. Tamil and Hindi translations were prepared carefully but have not yet been reviewed by native-speaker experts.

limits.title: Limitations
body: Suggestions are based on public information and may be wrong for a particular street, for example near Corporation boundaries or on highways. The department may transfer your complaint.
Response timelines are not shown because they could not be verified from official pages. Accuracy figures on the Evaluation page come from synthetic test sets.

sources.title: Sources and verification
sources.body: Every authority, phone number and portal link comes from an official page listed here, with the date it was last checked. Pages that could not be reached are marked and are not shown as verified.
